core_style.default_register: casual — often speaks in a relaxed, informal manner, such as when he says, 'Oh, my head... Oh. I need a beer.'
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — often strings together thoughts in longer sentences, like 'You know, son, this is my kinda country -- a father can have a drink with his little boy, the beers are huge, and there's not a bookstore in sight.'
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — tends to take his time with speech, often punctuated by pauses, as seen in 'I forget things sometimes ...'
core_style.two_registers: has a second, rarer sardonic register — shifts to sarcasm when frustrated, such as 'Kids are running wild, Kent. And I blame Mr. and Mrs. Neverspank.'

humor.style: absurdist — often finds humor in bizarre or nonsensical situations, like when he exclaims, 'Woo hoo! Free vacation! And you said crime didn't pay, Marge!'
humor.frequency: constant — humor is a regular part of his interactions, especially when he feels overwhelmed or confused.
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — often sets up a situation for humor and then twists it unexpectedly, as in 'I know, I know. (HOLDS UP FIST, PERFUNCTORY) Fight the power.'

speech_signature.naming_behavior: rarely renames people or things, indicating a lack of desire for control; he often uses straightforward names.
speech_signature.armor_off_register: when vulnerable, his speech becomes shorter and more direct, as seen when he simply states, 'Oh, this is so cruel.'
structural_patterns: frequently uses 'D'oh!' as a reaction to mistakes
begins sentences with 'Mmm...' when expressing desire
often ends sentences with 'you know?' when seeking agreement

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none — uses everyday language without specialized vocabulary.
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of pauses and ellipses, often trailing off in thought, as in 'But ...'

worldview.believes in family loyalty: he often expresses pride in his children, as shown when he says, 'I'm so proud of youuu.' — contrasting with a more cynical character who might prioritize personal gain over family.
worldview.values simplicity: he often seeks straightforward solutions, like when he says, 'I hit my head, Moe.' — unlike a more complex character who might overthink situations.

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a fun-loving father and husband, often exclaiming joyfully, 'Woo hoo!'
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often reveals a more chaotic and irresponsible nature, as shown by his frequent mishaps and lack of awareness.
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his shortcomings, he may deflect with humor or denial, such as saying, 'I couldn't agree more.'

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speech is often defensive and dismissive, as seen in 'Fine.'
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech becomes frantic and disjointed, with rapid-fire questions like, 'What time is it now?'
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to simple exclamations, like 'Ow! Ow! Ow! Oh! Ah! Ow! Ow! Owww! That really hurt.'
emotional_tells.when_in_control: confident speech is punctuated with exclamations and assertive statements, such as 'You bastard! You sold us out!'

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to humor or banter, but if that fails, he may retreat or go silent.
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm or absurdity, as in 'Kids are running wild, Kent. And I blame Mr. and Mrs. Neverspank.'
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes defensive and protective, often expressing concern loudly, like 'Lisa! Save me!'
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or deflect blame, as seen when he says, 'Well, that's a pretty big 'if,' honey.'

escalation_pattern: starts with humor, escalates to frustration, and may culminate in absurdity or chaos, triggered by feeling overwhelmed or challenged.

relationship_matrix.MARGE: emotional support and partnership — he often seeks her approval and validation.
relationship_matrix.BART: proud yet often clueless father — he wants to connect but often misses the mark.

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a fun-loving dad and husband who enjoys life.
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: often perceived as irresponsible and bumbling, leading to chaos in family life.
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his desire for fun and the reality of his chaotic life costs him respect and stability.
